activities.description: Syleena asks Traci about watching her 'Iyanla: Fix My Life' episode and the most challenging aspect.

Traci explains the difficulty of watching the episode at home and re-experiencing her sisters' feedback. She talks about learning from the experience and gaining new understanding of her sisters' feelings.
Syleena expresses happiness that Traci gained a new perspective.
The hosts laugh and transition to the topic of Trina.
Traci jokingly talks about Trina's unique personality as a child.
Traci shares a story about Trina attending a house party and her awkward dancing.
Syleena asks Traci for more funny stories about Trina. Traci struggles to find another story and mentions how Trina makes them laugh. Kiana asks for a choreographer for the end of the show.
Kiana asks Trina to share about Tracy. Trina shares a story about Tracy's hot-headed personality and humorous moments.
Syleena asks about resolving arguments in a large family. Traci explains their approach to dealing with disagreements. Kiana reflects on the importance of family over business.
The hosts wrap up the segment.
